semantic_checks: The nuclear chart inserts the actual physical position X as electron i and T as the other electron. The pair chart inserts positions T+X/2 and T-X/2. These follow from the literal configuration splitting, spectator inverses and pairCoordinates definitions, with no changed sqrt(2) convention.

The output predicate quantifies every real physical X,T satisfying ||X||<min(r^2,D^-1) and ||T||<r, where r=min(1/1024,S^-1), S=7 physicalKSPointwiseRate(M,A), D=32S^2. It is not restricted to an assumed image of the KS map.
The actual KS map surjectivity proof handles both the positive ||X||+X_2 branch and its zero boundary. Its norm identity gives a preimage Y with ||Y||^2=||X||, including X=0.
Because r>0 and ||X||<r^2, the selected preimage satisfies ||Y||<r. Together with ||T||<r this is membership in the actual product max-norm Taylor ball.

Finite coordinate sup norms of the complex embeddings of X,T are bounded above by their real Euclidean norms. Positivity of S,D follows explicitly from A>=1. These facts justify D||X_complex||<1 and S||T_complex||<1 without any unproved equivalence of norms.
The actual lift identity rewrites f(Y,t0+T) as g(KS(Y),t0+T). Substitution KS(Y)=X and ||Y||^2=||X|| gives the exact physical coefficient ||X|| in front of B.

The generic surjectivity theorem is explicitly conditional on the previously established lifted identity and actual lift relationship. The nuclear/pair wrappers construct those premises from PhysicalKSBoxPointwiseData using existing proved identity theorems and definitional chart equalities.

PhysicalKSBoxPointwiseData specifies smoothness, real analyticity and factorial coordinate derivative estimates for the actual lifted function on an explicit box. It does not assume the desired physical A+|X|B identity. The A/B functions are the literal descended sums of the actual Taylor coefficient family.
X=0 and T=0 are inside the neighborhood. No continuity or analytic coordinate section of KS is selected or needed: a pointwise preimage with its proved norm suffices.

The predicate body supplies the physical identity. Joint complex analyticity of its A/B functions is provided by the separately proved dependency and is not silently a second conjunct of this predicate.
